page.layout: One page of text; a decorative woodcut strip at the top; a Greek line and a Latin verse passage; a large decorative initial at the start of the verse; a small catchword at the lower right edge.

main_text.l: Ἐμοὶ γὰρ τὸ ζῆν Χριστὸς, καὶ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν κέρδος. Id est.
Mihi enim est Christus & in vita &
mala Gens orta Adamo, quum Superi
Nec tesqua si quis forte per auia

page.notes: The large initial O is a woodcut letter; the verse uses long s printed as s. Line "Celant" at right edge is a catchword. Some words in the verse (e.g. "Syagam", "Syrtibus") may be misprinted; "Celant" is the catchword and "Syagam" is uncertain. Page number and running head are not printed.
